role: Instructions for AI coding agents working in this repository: keeping the code map current is part of every change.
toplevel: Two heading sections only; no text outside them.

units.does: Title section with no text of its own; contains the code-map section.

units.key: § Working in this repository > The code map is part of every change
units.does: States that docs/codemap/records holds a record per unit, that a call graph is built from the records and the code, and that CI (gates.yml, ci.yml, make ci) and the pre-commit hook fail while any record is missing, older than its code, or older than a change in what one of its callees does. Before a change: run codemap.py impact <path::key> (or make codemap-impact) and read the record, callers, triggers, tests, shared state and open findings. During: make codemap-guard; sync for added/removed units; rewrite each listed record against the code (removing fixed flags, adding found problems); re-read each re-check caller against its callee's new behaviour and fix the caller or its record; then stamp, callees before callers; guard clean before committing. High- and medium-severity findings only go down: a fix deletes the flag and lowers .ci/codemap_open_high.txt or .ci/codemap_open_med.txt in the same change; a new one is fixed, not recorded. Forbids stamping a record or a re-check that was not re-read, and rewording a record whose behaviour did not change (it sends every caller back). Every command named exists.
